title: People across Varginha report seeing spaceships

tellings.quote: Yes. If you walk throughout the city, there are always reports of people who have seen spaceships.

plain: A surgeon named Ahmed Foratu, who tells of his hospital in Brazil operating on an alien, spoke to the podcast host Jesse Michels about his city, Varginha. He says that if you walk anywhere in the city, there are always people who report having seen spaceships. To him it shows that strange sightings are an ordinary part of life there.
